page.layout: One printed page, framed by an ornamental woodcut border. Running head at top with page number left and title centred. Main text in one column inside the border. Marginal reference marks (N3 style symbols) in the left margin beside lines. A catchword-like word at the foot right "o-" is a hyphenated line end. Faint show-through text from the facing page on the right and a faint word at the foot left, not printed text of this page.

main_text.p: quens; nisi velimus Spiritum Sanctum à rebus vanis, puerilibus, & commentitiis similitudinem pretiosissimarum & verissimarum rerum desumpsisse, quod absit. Tale autem aurum pellucidum ut vitrum, quod gloriæ summum splendorem exprimat, in sola tinctura Philosophorum extat & à Paracelso ita describitur, Metam. suæ 9. Nostra tinctura rubea, (inquit) quæ in se astra auxi continet, est substantia fixa, incorruptibilis essentia, summa rubedinis, cujus pulvis croci instar, sed toto corpore instar rubini, fluxibilis in modum resina, translucida instar crystalli, fragilis ut vitrum, & superabundantis ponderis. page.notes: Marginal reference marks at left (N3 and N3-like symbols) beside the lines "autem aurum" and "Nostra tinctura"; their note text is not legible on the scan. Underlining in the original is not reproduced. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears at the right margin and foot; ignored. The word "o-" at the foot right is a line-end hyphen, not a catchword. Some letters in the second and third lines are uncertain due to scan quality.
